ObjectName.value: Kesho Park at the Toronto Zoo (3354803789)

Categories.value: Toronto Zoo|March 2009 in Toronto|Canada photographs taken on 2009-03-14|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2

ImageDescription.value:
In the summer, this is probably one of the best places in the city to go for a cold drink, especially if you have kids in tow. It's the upper food and beer garden in the African area of the Toronto Zoo. There were few around today - it doesn't actually open until late May - but on a hot day, the ability to be able to relax for at least a few minutes while the kids run around pointing out the various animals, is gold.

Unfortunately, given its relatively small size, it fills up quickly with tired parents and caregivers, all with the same thought on their mind.

Credit.value: Kesho Park at the Toronto Zoo
